title: Pre-Disclosure Experiment Menus: Oracle-Relative Risk and Joint Sample--Menu Asymptotics
summary: We study a resolution problem in local asymptotic decision theory: individual risks may admit Gaussian approximations that do not determine their vanishing difference. A finite menu of experiments is installed before context disclosure, although observations may be routed adaptively afterward. A greatest-element Blackwell order collapses adaptive routing to the best installed experiment and reduces the fixed-menu excess to an inverse-information distortion with frontier $A_k$.
